description: This file contains build definitions and macros for creating Chromium OS images tailored for the Google WiFi device based on the qcom-ipq4019 SoC. It defines build steps for copying and modifying kernel images, signing kernels with Chrome OS verified boot utility, and device-specific configurations including device identities and package dependencies.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Copies the target file to a temporary file, then appends the GPT partition table for Chromium OS images.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends the kernel partition to the image file using dd with specified block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Signs the kernel image for Chrome OS boot verification using the cros-vbutil utility, embedding the root partition UUID.
